title: Salmon miso soup with rice
summary: Salmon miso soup with rice is a japanese dinner built around salmon fillets and rice miso paste, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Warm the oil and soften the onion for Salmon miso soup with rice. Stir in the garlic, ginger and spices until they smell fragrant.
steps.tip: If the spices look dusty, give them a minute in the oil before any liquid goes in.

steps.instruction: Add salmon fillets and cook until it loses its raw look. Pour in the tomatoes or coconut and rice miso paste.
Simmer gently, lid ajar, until basmati rice is tender and the sauce coats a spoon. Add a splash of water if it sticks.
steps.tip: Taste Salmon miso soup with rice before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Taste for salt and acid, then rest the pan for a couple of minutes before serving Salmon miso soup with rice.  Serve with the rice, simmered in salted water until tender.
